rationale_evidence.statement: Formalizes Buddhi as mode-sensitive: B_t:(E_t,K_t,M_t)->{accept,reject,investigate,suspend,transform}. The same evidence E can lead to different actions depending on mode: in Sattva, E->B_S->investigate carefully; in Rajas, E->B_R->act/acquire immediately; in Tamas, E->B_T->ignore/suspend/block. Refines the earlier 'kernel always busy determining right and wrong' into: the kernel continuously evaluates the epistemic condition of its current state and determines which transitions are admissible under its current operational mode; a kernel may legitimately decide DO NOTHING because evidence is insufficient, and that itself is a Buddhi decision.
